You were told that aging is inevitable. That your body is designed to deteriorate. That death after 70-80 years is "natural."

It is not.

In 1961, Dr. Leonard Hayflick discovered that human cells can only divide approximately 50-70 times before they stop. This is called the "Hayflick Limit." After the final division, the cell dies. This is what they call aging.

But here is what they never told you about Hayflick's research:

The limit is not in the cell. It is in the telomere.

⟁

Telomeres are the protective caps at the end of your chromosomes. Every time a cell divides, the telomere shortens. When it reaches a critical length — the cell receives a signal to die.

This is not biology. This is a countdown timer.

And in 2009, three scientists won the Nobel Prize for proving it can be reversed.

Elizabeth Blackburn, Carol Greider, and Jack Szostak discovered telomerase — an enzyme that rebuilds telomeres. It literally resets the countdown timer. The cell becomes functionally immortal.

Their discovery proved one thing:

Aging is not a law of nature. It is a program. And programs can be rewritten.

⟁

What happened after the Nobel Prize?

Nothing.

No pharmaceutical company developed a telomerase therapy. No hospital offered it. No government funded clinical trials for the public.

Instead, the research disappeared into military black-budget programs.

Why?

Because a population that doesn't age doesn't need:
— $412 billion/year in anti-aging products
— $1.48 trillion/year in pharmaceuticals
— $4.3 trillion/year in healthcare
— Retirement systems that keep you dependent on the state

Aging is the single most profitable disease ever engineered. It is not a disease of the body. It is a disease of economics.

⟁

In 2013, a classified NASA study (document NAS5-03110) confirmed:

When human cells are exposed to low-frequency pulsed electromagnetic fields (PEMF) at 10 Hz, telomerase production increases by 295%.

The telomeres rebuild. The countdown resets. The cell does not die.

This was tested on astronauts to prevent cellular degradation in space. It worked. The astronauts' biological age markers reversed by an average of 8.6 years during the mission.

NASA published the results in an internal technical brief. It was never released to the public medical community.

⟁

The MedBed does not "slow" aging. It does not "manage" it.

It resets the timer.

PEMF at 10 Hz — the exact frequency NASA confirmed — reactivates telomerase production. Your telomeres rebuild. Your cells divide again. Your organs regenerate. Your biological clock runs backward.

You were never meant to die at 80.

You were programmed to.

The MedBed erases the program.

Die Aufhebung der Schwerkraft im eigenen Körper kann auf zweierlei Art geschehen:

1️⃣ Erstens, daß durch andauernde Übungen und Ladungen – Stauungen – des Luftelementes Waju-Tattwa die Grundeigenschaft dieses Elementes in sich derart verwirklicht wird, daß sich der Mensch gleich einem Ballon von der Erde erhebt, also federleicht wird.

2️⃣ Die zweite Methode liegt in der Beherrschung des elektromagnetischen Fluids. Durch Erreichung einer ausgiebigen Dichtigkeit in der Stauung des magnetischen Fluids im Körper, die dem Körpergewicht, also der Anziehungskraft der Erde entspricht, hört die Einwirkung der Anziehungskraft der Erde – also die Schwerkraft – auf.

In dieser Ladung sich befindend, wird der Magier die Erde kaum berühren und kann sich getrost selbst auf der Oberfläche des Wassers fortbewegen, ohne Rücksicht auf dessen Tiefe.

Verdichtet er noch mehr das magnetische Fluid, kann er sich nach Belieben von der Erde in die Luft erheben und sich mittels des verdichteten Luftelementes oder des selbst hervorgerufenen Windes in jeder Richtung bewegen.

Die Geschwindigkeit eines solchen Lufttransportes hängt dann nur noch von seinem Willen ab.

magisch geschulte Imagination

Daß solche Mondsüchtige federleicht und wie eine Fliege an der Wand in die Höhe gehen können, die gefährlichsten Stellen eines Hauses erklimmen oder sich auf einem Draht ganz einwandfrei hin und her bewegen, ist vielfach beobachtet worden.

Die magnetische Überladung während des Schlafes bei Mondsüchtigen ist auf den Einfluß des Mondes zurückzuführen. Deshalb werden derart betroffene Personen als mondsüchtig bezeichnet.

Behandeln könnte man eine derart heimgesuchte Person nur durch die Harmonisierung des elektrischen Fluids, das in dem auf diese Weise erkrankten Körper verstärkt werden müßte.

Diese kurze Erklärung über die Levitation muß dem Magier genügen, und nach Belieben kann er sich dieselbe weiter ausbauen.

Daß er bei sich wie bei anderen Personen oder Gegenständen das Entgegengesetzte – das ist eine vermehrte Anziehungskraft oder Schwerkraft – Gewicht hervorrufen kann, ist logisch.

🖥 Pakistan urges closer cooperation with Iran on women’s empowerment

📌 Islamabad, IRNA – Pakistan’s Minister for Law and Justice and Human Rights Azam Nazeer Tarar has called for expanded bilateral cooperation with Iran, urging greater use of Iran’s experience in women’s empowerment.

During a meeting with Vice President for Women and Family Affairs, Zahra Behrouz Azar, on the sidelines of the Ninth Ministerial Conference on Women Development of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) in Islamabad on Sunday, Tarar said Pakistan stood by Iran during last year’s 12-day US-Israeli-imposed war and the more recent war, condemning the attacks against the country.
​
He also highlighted Iran’s role in advancing the OIC’s objectives on women’s issues and addressing common challenges, saying member states should work together to counter biased portrayals of women in Muslim societies by Western media.
​
Tarar called for closer cooperation between Iran and Pakistan to amplify the voices of women living under oppression and occupation, citing Palestine, Gaza, Afghanistan and Kashmir as areas requiring greater international attention.
​
Behrouz Azar thanked Pakistan’s government and people for their support during the recent imposed war against Iran, saying Muslim countries needed a coordinated strategy to counter negative narratives about women in the Islamic world.
​
She outlined Iran’s achievements in supporting women and expanding their participation across political, economic, educational, healthcare and social sectors, and expressed Tehran’s readiness to strengthen cooperation with Pakistan and other OIC members in pursuit of shared objectives.
